messages:
jen: Heads-up — planning a staggered migration tonight to add user_settings.non_critical_flags and a small hotpatch to the feature-flagging table.
jen: Target change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Goal is no >30s exclusive locks on main.
jen: Plan TL;DR: 1) schema change (fast ADD COLUMN), 2) async backfill in small batches, 3) vacuum after. Will gate with a feature flag.
deploy-bot: noted. Scheduled window set for 2024-07-19 23:00-01:00 UTC (env: prod). Canary group: us-west-1 (3 hosts).
kevin: Can we run the backfill job with rate limiting and checkpointing? I can add resume points every 10k rows.
jen: yes — keep batch_size 5k-10k, throttle to ~200 rows/sec to avoid bloat. If we see lock wait >30s abort backfill.
sam: +1 on feature-flag gate. I recommend enabling the flag in canary hosts first, then gradual roll.
maria: watch MVCC bloat — suggest running VACUUM FULL on the affected partitions in the 01:05-01:20 UTC slot if safe. Also ensure autovacuum is not paused.
ops-bot: lock-watcher enabled for relation user_settings; alerts at 30s (warning) and 2m (critical) to #eng-oncall.
kevin: contingency: if index rebuilds are needed, we should switch to CONCURRENTLY and stagger across replicas.
jen: rollback plan: 1) stop backfill jobs, 2) flip feature-flag off, 3) revert application runtime pin if we rolled it, 4) run small compaction/vacuum cleanup as needed. DB snapshot at 22:30 available for restore.
sam: what's the runtime pin request?
jen: pining app runtime to 3.2.1 for the deploy so we don't get new DB client connection behavior during the window. After canary succeeds we unpin.
kevin: I can kick off the canary at 23:00 to the 3 hosts, confirm healthchecks pass for 5m, then continue. If any host reports >500ms p95 on /write endpoints we abort.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: group "us-west-canary" at 23:00 UTC. Will post status updates.
jen: SQL we'll run for the column add (fast path):
```sql
ALTER TABLE user_settings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS non_critical_flags jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT VALID;
-- validate in batches after backfill
```
kevin: backfill example job (pseudo):
```bash
python backfill.py --batch-size=5000 --throttle=200 --checkpoint=10000 --table=user_settings
```
ops-bot: preflight checklist completed: runbook link <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/migrations#user_settings>, pg_stat_activity monitor enabled.
maria: note in release notes: "Add non_critical_flags column (backfilled asynchronously). Gate via ff:non_critical_flags" — include rollback steps.
jen: agreed — I'll update release notes and the deploy ticket. Also adding explicit note to not run heavy analytics jobs in the 23:00-02:00 UTC range.
sam: one more: ensure deploy-bot has pin flag set so autoscaler doesn't replace canary hosts mid-window.
deploy-bot: runtime pin applied for deploy id 87421. Autoscaler suspended for canary group for 1h.
kevin: If we hit >2m lock critical, immediate abort and signal DB restore readiness. Ops team will manage snapshot restore.
jen: OK team — final readiness check at 22:45 UTC. If no objections by then, we proceed with the plan. Will post final go/no-go here. :thumbsup:
